fichas.title: Glazed lifts
fichas.summary: Glazed lifts provide a view and can improve users’ feeling of safety. They may use glazed shafts subject to fire-resistance requirements or be shaftless panoramic lifts, which are restricted to locations where lift shafts are not permitted. Glazing must prevent users from reaching moving parts. These non-standard constructions require special prototype approval.

dimensions.label: Safety barrier height around shaft doors
dimensions.context: Minimum height around shaft doors to prevent contact with moving parts.

dimensions.label: Safety barrier height on other sides
dimensions.context: Minimum height on sides other than the shaft doors.
dimensions.ocr_raw: and on the other sides min. 2.5 m

dimensions.label: Distance from barrier to moving parts
dimensions.context: Minimum distance to moving parts; barrier height may be reduced when distances are greater.
dimensions.ocr_raw: with the distance to moving parts at least 0.5 m

fichas.title: Goods and underfloor lifts without passenger transport
fichas.summary: Lifts intended only for loads, such as rubbish bins or goods deliveries, may be installed inside or in front of a building. Passenger transport is not permitted, and a machine room is not normally necessary. Underfloor lifts are controlled from the uppermost station, and their covers must remain in the operator’s field of view.

fichas.title: Lifts with reduced shaft dimensions
fichas.summary: Special lifts for refurbishment projects can reduce the required pit depth and shaft head height. Shaft ventilation, possible ceiling condensation and fire protection must be considered for installations without machine rooms; the manufacturer’s requirements apply. The illustrated examples include traction lifts and special constructions, with several dimensions shown in the diagrams.

dimensions.context: Approximate minimum pit depth described for special lifts in refurbishment projects.

dimensions.context: Approximate minimum height above the highest stop described for special lifts.

LIFTS

I

-

I
Balustrade

Glazed lifts
Glazed lifts offer a view and improve the users' feeling of safety.
They can be constructed either with glazed shafts (observing
fire resistance requirements) or as shaftless lifts (panoramic
lifts) --7 0. These can only be installed near buildings in which,
to prevent the spread of fire, no lift shafts are permitted. This
makes the inclusion of panoramic lifts into traffic calculations
difficult. The glazing must prevent the users touching moving
parts with the hand or with objects held in the hand. Glazed lifts
are non-standard constructions and require a special prototype
approval.

Special Lifts

_J.---'---'-.LL.LL-'----'- Ground floor

Glazing

Goods and underfloor lifts (without passenger transport)
Lifts only intended for loads like rubbish bins or goods deliveries
can be installed inside a building or in front of it --7 f). Passenger
transport is not permissible with this type of lift. A machine room
is not normally necessary.

;:;:;::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::·;1:(:::::::::::::;:::

tDJ
Ground floor

0 Contact with moving parts must be prevented in glazed lifts: safety barrier
around shaft doors min. up to 3.5 m high and on the other sides min. 2.5 m,
with the distance to moving parts at least 0.5 m; with greater distances, the
height can be reduced.

I II ll

Underfloor lifts are controlled from the uppermost station. The
cover of the lift must be in the field of view of the operator.
Lifts with reduced shaft dimensions
In refurbishment projects, it is often a major inconvenience to
construct the parts of the shaft above and below the working
range. For such projects, there are special lifts, which require
less pit depth (min. approx. 80 mm) and shaft head heights (min.
approx. 2500 mm above the highest stop) --7 8 - 0. When lifts
are installed without machine rooms, special requirements have
to be considered for the shaft (ventilation, possible condensation
on the ceiling and fire protection measures). These requirements
can be taken from the information provided by the particular
manufacturer, because such lifts have to undergo a special
prototype approval.

Such special constructions also include lifts for disabled
people --7 0, which may be used only by the specified group.
Dead man's controls and similar measures make simple, spacesaving installations without pit and car doors permissible. Home
stairlifts enable those with impaired mobility to move easily
between floors (on straight or curved stairways) and across
landings. The requirements for such installations are provided
in BS 5776.

f) Load and goods lifts. Because passengers are not allowed to travel, the car
does not require doors. This results in a good relationship between shaft crosssection and usable car area.

fichas.title: Lifts for disabled people and home stairlifts
fichas.summary: Special lifts for disabled people are approved solely for use by the specified group. Dead-man’s controls and similar measures permit simple, space-saving installations without a pit or car doors. Home stairlifts help people with impaired mobility travel between floors on straight or curved stairs and across landings. The stated requirements reference BS 5776.
uses: Mobility between floors for people with impaired mobility
